subject: Request for signed internship agreement
text: Hi, Could you please send me the signed internship agreement from last month? I am updating my academic records before Friday and need a small favor. If the file is in the shared folder, a simple reply with the link or PDF attachment would be enough. I only need the page with my name and the date. I appreciate you checking during the afternoon. The document would help me confirm that the required placement hours are recorded correctly and submitted to the office.
